title: Random Point In Non-Overlapping Rectangles
description: Pick a random point inside one of the given non-overlapping rectangles with probability proportional to the area.
pseudocode:
1. totalArea = sum(areas)
2. weights = cumulativeSum(areas)
3. rand = Math.random() * totalArea
4. index = binarySearch(weights, rand)
5. rect = rects[index]
6. x = randInt(rect.x1, rect.x2)
7. y = randInt(rect.y1, rect.y2)
8. return [x, y]

steps.note: Calculate areas: R0 (1x1=1), R1 (2x2=4). Total area = 5.
Generate random value between 0 and 5. Let's say 2.5.
Pick random x-coordinate within R1 bounds.
Pick random y-coordinate within R1 bounds.
